evidence.quote: NABARD seeks an Enterprise KYC, KYB, CKYC & AML Solution for development, implementation, integration and roll-out across NABARD applications and systems.

The Bidder shall develop, configure, customize, implement and roll out an integrated enterprise Solution covering Individual KYC, Entity KYB, CKYC registry integration and lifecycle management, and AML/CFT capabilities
The Bidder should have experience in the development, implementation and management of KYC, CKYC and AML solutions, whether implemented under a single project or through multiple projects
